verdict.rationale: Datalab's conversion docs say Marker "handles complex layouts, tables, math, and images" (datalab-docs-52), so images are handled during conversion. Separately, structured extraction offers "citations back to source bounding boxes" (datalab-docs-18), which shows position traceability exists somewhere in the platform. Neither item shows that figures or charts specifically come out as crops or VLM descriptions with page coordinates. missing for 10: documented figure/chart image-crop output, VLM-generated chart or figure descriptions, bounding-box or page provenance on extracted figures, independent or hands-on corroboration of figure extraction quality.
